verdict.rationale: A video API platform could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant in its dashboard or developer portal, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only video sessions, the Media Router, archiving, webhooks and pricing, with no mention of an in-product assistant for delegating tasks. The llms.txt probe is machine-readable documentation, not an assistant, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
